app_tagline: Restore missing information in your Immich library
auth_intro: Sign in with your Immich account. You will see and change only your own library.
auth_help_steps: In Immich, open Account Settings → API Keys → New API Key.
auth_help_storage: The key is stored encrypted on the server of this app and is never sent back to the browser.
error_unexpected: Something went wrong. Please try again.
error_core_unreachable: The app server does not respond.
error_server_not_configured: The app is not configured yet: set the Immich address and the secret key on the server.
error_immich_unreachable: The Immich server does not respond.
error_immich_missing_permissions: The API key lacks permissions: {permissions}. Edit the key in Immich and try again.
error_immich_permission_denied: Immich refused the request: the API key lacks a permission.
photo_video_note: Video: the preview frame is shown.
photo_coordinates_invalid: Could not read the coordinates. Examples: 42.4249, 18.7713 or 42°25'30"N 18°46'17"E
photo_keys_hint: Keys: Enter save the location, ← → previous / next, S skip, N not applicable, U back to the to-do list, Z enlarge the photo, Esc gallery. Click the map to pick a point.
error_immich_error: Immich returned an error. Please try again.
error_location_changed_in_immich: The location was changed in Immich after this app wrote it. Undo was cancelled so as not to overwrite it.
photo_save_note: The location is written to Immich a few seconds after saving; until then it can be cancelled.
photo_pending: The location of this photo will be saved in a few seconds.
error_location_null_island: Exactly 0, 0 cannot be saved: Immich treats it as "no location".
error_location_clear_failed: Immich did not remove the coordinates, so the saved point was kept.
auth_password_note: The password is checked by Immich and is not stored. On the first sign-in the app creates its own API key in your Immich account (named “immich-steward …”) and keeps it encrypted on its server.
auth_key_summary: Sign in with an API key instead
auth_key_intro: For example, if you sign in to Immich through OAuth and have no password.
auth_help_optional_download: optional: shows originals in full size
error_immich_invalid_credentials: Immich did not accept this email and password.
error_immich_password_login_failed: Immich refused password sign-in (it may be turned off on the server). Sign in with an API key instead.
